description: Per-field merge: the refiner's match list declares merge=union, so the user layer's refinement appends to the base layer's list instead of overwriting it; suffix src, held by both layers, appears once (declared-shape dedup), prefix core survives beside suffix core because the union variant is part of the shape, and the held base items precede the appended user items; the scalar layer field still overwrites and the resolution lists both layers, highest first
